items.title: Are you safe?
lines: If you are hurt or in danger, call the emergency number first.
You can call it from any phone, even without a SIM card.
Somewhere else? Try 112 from a mobile phone. Most networks connect it to the local emergency number.

items.title:
Keep calm
and
carry on
lines: Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Do it 3 times.
It happened to us too. We will go through it one step at a time.

items.title: On a borrowed phone or computer?
lines: Open a private window.
Sign out of every account when you are done.

items.title: Block payments
lines: Call your bank. The number is on the back of your card and on the bank website.

lines.text: 1️⃣ Ask them to block your cards in Apple Pay and their banking app on the stolen phone.
1️⃣ Ask them to block your cards in Google Wallet and their banking app on the stolen phone.

lines: 2️⃣ Wallet stolen too? Ask them to block the cards as well.
Ask about any payments made since the theft.

items.title: Block your SIM card
items.time: About 10 minutes, plus time on hold
lines: Call your mobile operator from any phone.
1️⃣ Ask them to block the SIM.
➡️ A blocked SIM cannot be used to receive login codes.

items.title: Lock your phone
lines: On any phone or computer, open the page for your phone. Sign in.

lines.text: Asked for a code you cannot get? Try android.com/lock. It needs only your phone number.

lines: The same page shows where the phone is. Do not go there yourself. Give the location to the police.

items.question: Lock your email
lines: Open your email in a new tab. Go to the security settings.
Can you get in?

items.title: Lock your email

lines.text: ➡️ Forgot your password? Choose Forgot password.
➡️ Asked for a code by SMS or on an authenticator? On the sign-in page, choose Try another way. A backup code or a security key works too.
➡️ Still signed in on a laptop or tablet? Use that. It may not ask for a code.
➡️ No other way in? Start account recovery
Once you are in, go to the security settings.

lines: Remove the stolen phone from your devices and sign-in methods.
1️⃣ Choose Sign out of all other devices.
2️⃣ Change the password.
Next, do the same for your other accounts (social media, banks, paypal ...)

items.title: Report the theft to the police
lines: ⚠️ Get a copy of the report and a reference number.
Your insurer and your operator will ask for them.

lines.text: Bring the IMEI number if you can find it. It is on the phone box, and in your Apple account.
Bring the IMEI number if you can find it. It is on the phone box, and in your Google account.

items.title: Erase your phone
items.time: When you are sure it is gone
lines: Use the same page you used to lock it. Choose Erase.
After you erase it, you may not see where it is.
Do not remove the phone from your account. Then it stays locked for the thief.
